versions.changelog:
popai-presentation-slides 1.0.0

- Initial release of the PopAI PowerPoint skill.
- Generate presentations (PPT) using the PopAI API with built-in research and information gathering capabilities.
- Accepts topic prompts, reference files (pptx/pdf/docx/images), PPT templates, and URLs for content sources.
- Supports multi-round PPT modification via channel ID; template remains fixed after creation.
- Outputs include downloadable PPTX link, web editing link, and slide preview images.
- Real-time progress and status updates are provided during generation and revisions.
